description: Aggregate a company's GTM signals into one composite score. Runs hiring-signal and tech-stack detection in a single call and returns a flat, Clay-ready JSON row with a composite GTM score, a recommended action, and an optional plain-English summary. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: Bare company domain without https:// and without a trailing slash. Example: stripe.com

explain_mode.description: If true, gtm_signal_summary becomes a longer, more detailed explanation instead of a 1 to 2 sentence summary.

include_summary.description: Include a plain-English gtm_signal_summary field in the output. Defaults to the actor's default when omitted.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

sources.description: Which signals to aggregate. Default ["hiring", "tech_stack"], which is what this actor has always run. Each extra source is one more sub actor run on the caller's own Apify account, so this is the cost dial as well as the depth dial. The composite score is normalized over the sources you selected, so a funding only run is scored on its own scale rather than capped by absent sources.

name: aggregate_gtm_signals
title: Aggregate GTM Signals
